book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mataayo

content: Abhakaangati bha Abhayahudi bharakora omukoonyo okumwiita Yeesu
Hano Yeesu yamariri okugaamba amangʼana gayo goosi, akabhabhuurira abhaanabheega bhaaye,
“Kyeego mumenyiri, hano zikuhita eziisiku ibhiri, turabha ne Enyaangi yo Okuhiita.
Kurusiku ruyo, enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, ndatuurwa mumabhoko ga abhabhisa, okubha niitwe kumusaraba.”
Ambe, eriibhaga riyo, abhakuru bha abhaseengeri
na abhakaruka bha Abhayahudi bhakiikumania mwiibhaanza rye enyuumba yo omuseengeri omukuru, wuno akubhirikirwa Kayafa.
Muyo, bhakiibhuurya kyeego bharaamugwaate Yeesu kwe embiso, okubha bhamwiite.
Bhakiikirirania, “Nawe tutaaza tukore gano mu Nyaangi yo Okuhiita, abhaatu bhataaza kukora orwaambi.”
Omukari aramwiituruurira Yeesu amaguta
Niho Yeesu akagya mumugye gwa Betania, akiikara munyuumba ya Simooni wuno ekare yaari ne ebhigeenge.

Hano Yeesu yaari kwiigari kurya, akaaza omukari wumwe yaari ne enzubha yino yakorirwe kwe eriigina rya arabasita ryo obhuguri bhukuru. Muusi we enzubha yiyo, kwaari na amaguta go omuruumbaaso gano gano obhuguri bhukuru bhukongʼu. Omukari wuyo akamwiituruurira Yeesu kumutwe kwo okumusuuka.
Hano abhaanabheega bhaaye bhaaruuzi gayo, bhakatiinda. Bhakabhuga, “Bhamure! Kwaki omukari wuno arasarya amaguta go obhuguri bhukuru ego?
Yiingabheeri bhuzomu amaguta gano gaguribhwe kwe eziimbirya nzaru, na ziingasakiirye abhataka!”
Hano Yeesu akamenyeekererya amangʼana gayo, akabhabhuurira, “Kwaki muramunyaakya omukari wuno? Ewe anikoreeri eriingʼana izomu bhukongʼu.
Abhataka bhari hamwe neemwe eziisiku zyoosi, nawe enye nitakubha hamwe neemwe eziisiku zyoosi.
Hano omukari wuno anituruuriiri amaguta, akakora ego okubha abhanure omubhiri gwaane kwo okubhiikwa kwaane.
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, hayo hoosi hano gararwaazwa Amangʼana Amazomu iguru waane mukyaaro kyoosi, riragaambwa izomu rino omukari wuno anikoreeri, na abhaatu bharamuhiita.”
Yuuda Isikariyoti ariikirirya okumurya omukoonyo Yeesu
Ambe, owumwe wa abhaanabheega bha Yeesu ikumi na bhabhiri, wuno akubhirikirwa Yuuda Isikariyoti, akagya kubhakuru bha abhaseengeri,
akabhabhuurya, “Muranihaki hano ndaabhagwaatye Yeesu mumabhoko geenyu?” Kyaamwe bhakamuha eziimbirya miroongo etatu (30).
Kweemera eriibhaga riyo, Yuuda akataanga okumoohya eriibhaga izomu ryo okumurya omukoonyo.
Yeesu ararya na abhaanabheega bhaaye bhararyaEnyaangi yo Okuhiita
Kurusiku rwo okutaanga rwe Enyaangi ye Emikaate Gino Gitana Ekibhwiisya,
abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhakaaza kweewe, bhakamubhuurya, “Oreenda tugye hayi tukubhanurire ebhyaakurya bhye Enyaangi yo Okuhiita?”

Yeesu akabhaha eriina ryo omuutu omurebhe akabhabhuurira, “Mugye mumugye gwa Yerusaremu kumuutu wuyo, mumubhuurire, ‘Omweegya atutumeenie, arabhuga: Eriibhaga ryaane riisukiri. Enye na abhaanabheega bhaane turarya ebhyaakurya bhye Enyaangi yo Okuhiita munyuumba yaazo.’”
Abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakagya bhakakora goosi kyeego Yeesu yabharageenie, bhakabhanura ebhyaakurya bhye Enyaangi yo Okuhiita.
Hano yahikiri engoroobha, Yeesu na abhaanabheega bhaaye ikumi na bhabhiri bhaari kwiigari bhararya.
Hano bhaari kurya, Yeesu akabhuga, “Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, owumwe weenyu aranirya omukoonyo.”
Abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakabha ne ebhigoongi bhukongʼu, bhakataanga okumubhuurya owumwe kwo owumwe, “Ee Omukuru, enye neenye ndaakurye omukoonyo?”
Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Ni wuno akukorya mukitubha kimwe na neenye, niwe araanirye omukoonyo.

Enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, ndiitwa kyeego yakaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru. Nawe, araaza kurora omuutu wuno araanirye omukoonyo enye Omwaana wo Omuutu. Yiingabheeri hakiriku kweewe omuutu wuyo atiingibhwiirwe!”
Ambe, Yuuda omuri wo omukoonyo, neewe akamubhuurya Yeesu, “Ee Omweegya, enye neenye ndaakurye omukoonyo?” Yeesu akamukyoora, “Naawe ogaambiri.”
Ambe, hano bhaari kurya, Yeesu akagega omukaate, akabhuga, “Ozomirye, Taatabhugya,” akagubhega, akabhaha abhaanabheega bhaaye, akabhabhuurira, “Mugege murye, omukaate guno nigwo omubhiri gwaane.”
Akagega ekikoombe kya amaanzi amahya go omuzabibu, akabhuga, “Ozomirye, Taatabhugya,” akabhaha, akabhabhuurira, “Mugege amaanzi go omuzabibu gano, munywe emwe mwoosi.
Amaanzi go omuzabibu gayo, nigo amanyiinga gaane ge eriiragano.
Amanyiinga gaane gariitika kwiiguru ya abhaatu bhaaru, okubha Taatabhugya abhaabhire ebhibhi bhyaabhu.
Ndabhabhuurira, nitakunywa kweeki amaanzi go omuzabibu tee orusiku runo ndaanywe kwe enzira ehya hamwe neemwe mubhutemi bhwa Taata waane.”
Niho bhakeemba omweembo gwo okumukumya Taatabhugya. Bhakatanura hayo, bhakagya mu Kiguru kye Emizeituni.
Yeesu araroota kubha Petero aramwaanga
Ambe, Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaanabheega bhaaye, “Obhutiku bhwa reero, emwe mwoosi muraaningʼosa no okunitiga. Erabha ego, kwo okubha Amakaamo Amahoreeru gakubhuga,
“Nawe enye hano ndaaryookibhwe, ndabhakaangatira kugya Gariraaya.”
Kyaamwe, Petero akamubhuurira Yeesu, “Naabhe bhoosi bharaakutige, enye nitakukutiga kimwe!”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Ndakubhuurira obhuheene, obhutiku bhuno hano ekorokoome ekyaari kugaamba, orabha omariri kunianga katatu koosi.”
Petero akamukyoora, “Eraabhe ereenderwa nikwe hamwe naawe, enye nitakukwaanga eheene!” Abhaanabheega abhaandi bhoosi nabho, bhakabhuga egoego.
Yeesu arasabha Taatabhugya mumuguundu gwa Getisemane
Ambe, Yeesu akagya na abhaanabheega bhaaye kumusabha Taatabhugya mumuguundu guno gukubhirikirwa Getisemane. Hano bhaahikiri, akabhabhuurira, “Mwiikare hano, enye ndagya erya okumusabha Taatabhugya.”
Akamugega Petero hamwe na abhamura bhabhiri bha Zebedaayo. Yeesu akataanga kubha ne ebhigoongi no okuyaangayaanga mukoro yaaye.
Hano bhaahikiri akabhabhuurira, “Ekoro yaane ene ebhigoongi bhyaaru. Mwiikare hano, muteengeeze hamwe neenye.”
Akiisuka embere hasuuhu, akahigama haasi bhubhuumari, akasabha Taatabhugya, “Ee Taata waane, eraaturikane, ndakusabha onduusiryeho eziinyaako zino.
Otaaza kukora kyeego enye nikweenda, nawe okore kyeego awe okweenda.”
Ambe, Yeesu akakyoora hano yaari atigiri abhaanabheega bhaaye, akabhona bhahiindiiri eziitiro. Akamubhuurya Petero, “Mbe, mutamirwe kuteengeeza hamwe neenye naabhe kwe esa yimwe?
Muteengeeze no okumusabha Taatabhugya, okubha mutaaza kusakibhwa. Ekoro ereenda nawe omubhiri ni munyookobhu.”
Yeesu akabhatiga hayo kweeki, akagya eyo orugeendo rwa kabhiri, akamusabha Taatabhugya, “Ee Taata waane, eraabhe eziinyaako zino zitakunagya okurwa kweenye, ambe gakorwe kyeego okweenda.”
Ambe, hano yakyooriri kubhaanabheega bhaaye, akabhabhona bhahiindiiri eziitiro kweeki, kwo okubha bhataanagirye kuramukya ameeso gaabhu.
Yeesu akabhatiga kweeki, akagya kumusabha Taatabhugya orugeendo rwa katatu, akakyoorera okugaamba amangʼana garyagarya.

Ambe, hano yakyooriri kweeki kubhaanabheega bhaaye, akabhabhuurira, “Mukyaari muhiindiiri no okumuunya? Murore! Eriibhaga ryo okunyaakibhwa kwaane riisukiri, enye Omwaana wo Omuutu ndagwaatwa no okuhirwa kubhakori bhe ebhibhi.
Mwiimuke, tugye. Murore! Omuri waane wo omukoonyo ari haguhi!”
Yeesu aragwaatwa

Hano Yeesu yaari akyaakeerenia amangʼana gayo, Yuuda, owumwe wa abhaanabheega bhaaye ikumi na bhabhiri, akaaza hamwe ne esaango ekuru ya abhaatu bhe eziinyaambato ne eziinduguzo. Esaango yiyo ekatumanibhwa na abhakuru bha abhaseengeri na abhakaruka bha Abhayahudi.
Omuri wo omukoonyo wuyo, yaari akaangatiri okubhabhuurira abhaatu bhayo ekyeerekenio. Akabhabhuurira, “Omuutu wuno ndaamukeerye kwo okumuhuumbata, niwe wuyo, mumugwaate!”
Hano bhaahikiri, Yuuda akagya ku Yeesu, akamukeerya, “Omweegya, wareeri!” Kyaamwe akamuhuumbata.
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Musaani waane, okore kino wiiziri kukora.” Ambe abhaatu bhayo bhakiisuka, bhakamugwaata Yeesu no okumubhoha.
Niho owumwe wa abhaanabheega bha Yeesu, akasohora nyaambato, akamutema no okumutina okutwi omugya wo omuseengeri omukuru.
Nawe Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Kyoorya nyaambato mukyoobho, kwo okubha abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhakugwaata nyaambato okubha bhiite, nabho bhariitwa kwa nyaambato!
Mbe, otamenyiri kubha ndanagya okusabha Taata waane obhusakirya, neewe aratura okunitumanirya bhamaraika kukira amahizo amakuru ikumi na abhiri?
Nawe, eraabhe ndikora ego, igabhwi garanagya kukuunaana gano gakaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru kubha, niigo gakweenderwa kubha?”
Niho Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaatu bhe esaango yiyo, “Mbe, mwiiziri ne eziinyaambato ne eziinduguzo okunigwaata kyo omuteesya? Ndora eziisiku zyoosi niari ndeegya mwiiseengerero, nawe mutaanigwaatiri!
Nawe gano goosi gaatuukiri, okubha gakorwe gano abharooti bhaakaamiri mu Makaamo Amahoreeru.” Ambe, abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhoosi bhakangʼosa, bhakamutiga.
Yeesu embere wa abhakuru bha Abhayahudi
Ambe, abhaatu bhano bhaamugwaatiri Yeesu, bhakagya nawe, bhakamuhira munyuumba ya Kayafa omuseengeri omukuru, muno bhaari bhiikumeenie abheegya bhe emigiro gya Musa na abhakaruka bha Abhayahudi.

Eriibhaga riyo, Petero yaari aramutuniirira Yeesu kwa kure, tee mwiibhaanza rye enyuumba yo omuseengeri omukuru. Kyaamwe akasikira muusi, akiikara hamwe na abhariibhi okubha arore kyeego amasemo ga Yeesu garaabhe.
Abhakuru bha abhaseengeri ne ekiina ekikuru
kyoosi kya Abhayahudi, bhaari bhareenda abhamenyeekererya bho orurimi okubha bhayibhone enzira yo okumwiita Yeesu.
Bhakaaza abhamenyeekererya bho orurimi bhaaru, nawe bhataabhweeni obhumenyeekererya bhwobhwoosi bhuno bhwaabhangʼariiri.
Mubhuteero, abhamenyeekererya bhabhiri bhakaaza, bhakabhuga, “Omuutu wuno yabhugiri, ‘Ndanagya okusarya eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya no okwoomboka kweeki kwe eziisiku isatu.’ ”
Kyaamwe omuseengeri omukuru akiimeerera, akamubhuurya Yeesu, “Ndora, otakukyoora ryoryoosi? Amangʼana gano abhaatu bhano bhakukuzoongera, orabhugabhwi?”

Nawe Yeesu ataakyooriri kiyo kyoosi. Ambe, omuseengeri omukuru wuyo akamubhuurira, “Ndakwiirahirya kwe eriina rya Taatabhugya wuno ari muhoru, otubhuurire eraabhe awe naawe Masiya, Omwaana wa Taatabhugya.”

Yeesu akamukyoora, “Naawe ogaambiri. Nawe ndabhabhuurira bhoosi, kweemera bhoono muraandora enye Omwaana wo Omuutu, ndabha niikeeri orubhaara rwo obhuryo rwa Taatabhugya wo obhunagya bhwoosi. Kweeki muranirora eriibhaga nikuuza kureka mwiisaaro.”

Ambe, hano omuseengeri omukuru yiigwiiri amangʼana gayo, akangʼaarura eziingibho zyaaye, akabhuga, “Aa! Yiiriingʼeenie na Taatabhugya! Ambe, ni bhamenyeekereryaki kweeki bhano tukweenda? Mwiigwiiri emwe abheene kyeego akumutuka Taatabhugya!
Kweego emwe murabhuga igabhwi?” Bhakamukyoora, “Areenderwa yiitwe!”
Kyaamwe, bhakataanga okumutweera Yeesu amate mubhusyo, bhakamutema ebhikuundi. Abhaandi bhakamutema oruhi,
no okumubhuurira, “Ee Masiya, turootere, ni weewi wuno akutemiri?”
Petero aramwaanga Yeesu
Ambe, kwe eriibhaga riyoriyo, Petero yaari yiikeeri mwiibhaanza igutu hayo. Niho omuhokya owumwe omuukya akamwiisukira Petero, akamubhuurira, “Awe woosi waari hamwe na Yeesu Omugariraaya.”
Nawe Petero akaanga embere ya abhaatu bhoosi, akubhuga, “Nitamenyiri gano okubhuga!”
Niho akatanura hano yaari, akagya mukiseku. Omuukya owuundi omugya akamurora, akabhabhuurira abhaatu bhano bhaari hayo, “Omuutu wuno yaari hamwe na Yeesu Omunazareeti.”
Petero akaanga kweeki, akiirahira, akabhuga, “Nitamumenyiri omuutu wuyo!”

Eriibhaga iguhi rikahita, abhaatu bhano bhaari abhamenyeekererya hayo, bhakamwiisukira Petero, bhakamubhuurira, “Eheene, awe ni wumwe mubhaatu bhano bhari hamwe na Yeesu. Naabhe obhugaambi bhwaazo bhureerekya mwaasi orarwa Gariraaya!”
Petero akataanga okwiihiimirirya bhukongʼu, akiirahira, akabhuga, “Nitamumenyiri omuutu wuyo!” Hayohayo, ekorokoome ekagaamba.

Niho Petero akahiita amangʼana gano Yeesu yaari amubhuuriiri, “Hano ekorokoome ekyaari kugaamba, orabha omariri kunianga katatu koosi.” Kyaamwe, akahuruka igutu, akabha ararira kwo obhururu bhukongʼu.
